newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shiseido to buy Carter-Wallace's US facilities.
newsitem.headline: Shiseido to buy Carter-Wallace's US facilities.

text.p: Japanese cosmetics company Shiseido Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it had agreed to buy U.S. consumer products maker Carter-Wallace Inc's production facilities in New Jersey.
Shiseido also agreed with Pipco Ewing Inc of the United States to buy a parcel of land adjacent to the Carter-Wallace facilities in East Windsor, New Jersey, Shiseido said in a statement.
The total cost of the production facilities and the land is $7 million, Shiseido said.
The facilities, which will mainly produce skincare products, will become a major manufacturing base for Shiseido in North America, it said.
Operations at the facilities are scheduled to start in the first half of 1998.
As a result of the agreement, Shiseido's North American production capacity will increase from the current 90 million units a year to 200 million units a year by 2000, Shiseido said.
